verses.text: For the choir director; according to Jeduthun. A Psalm of David. My soul [waits] in silence for God only; From Him is my salvation.
verses.textZh: （大衛的詩，照耶杜頓的作法，交與伶長。）我的心默默無聲，專等候神；我的救恩是從他而來。

verses.text: He only is my rock and my salvation, My stronghold; I shall not be greatly shaken.
verses.textZh: 惟獨他是我的磐石，我的拯救；他是我的高臺，我必不很動搖。

verses.text: How long will you assail a man, That you may murder [him], all of you, Like a leaning wall, like a tottering fence?
verses.textZh: 你們大家攻擊一人，把他毀壞，如同毀壞歪斜的牆、將倒的壁，要到幾時呢？

verses.text: They have counseled only to thrust him down from his high position; They delight in falsehood; They bless with their mouth, But inwardly they curse. Selah.
verses.textZh: 他們彼此商議，專要從他的尊位上把他推下；他們喜愛謊話，口雖祝福，心卻咒詛。（細拉）

verses.text: My soul, wait in silence for God only, For my hope is from Him.
verses.textZh: 我的心哪，你當默默無聲，專等候神，因為我的盼望是從他而來。

verses.text: He only is my rock and my salvation, My stronghold; I shall not be shaken.
verses.textZh: 惟獨他是我的磐石，我的拯救；他是我的高臺，我必不動搖。

verses.text: On God my salvation and my glory [rest]; The rock of my strength, my refuge is in God.
verses.textZh: 我的拯救、我的榮耀都在乎神；我力量的磐石、我的避難所都在乎　神。

verses.text: Trust in Him at all times, O people; Pour out your heart before Him; God is a refuge for us. Selah.
verses.textZh: 你們眾民當時時倚靠他，在他面前傾心吐意；神是我們的避難所。（細拉）

verses.text: Men of low degree are only vanity and men of rank are a lie; In the balances they go up; They are together lighter than breath.
verses.textZh: 下流人真是虛空；上流人也是虛假；放在天平裡就必浮起；他們一共比空氣還輕。

verses.text: Do not trust in oppression And do not vainly hope in robbery; If riches increase, do not set [your] heart [upon them].
verses.textZh: 不要仗勢欺人，也不要因搶奪而驕傲；若財寶加增，不要放在心上。

verses.text: Once God has spoken; Twice I have heard this: That power belongs to God;
verses.textZh: 神說了一次、兩次，我都聽見：就是能力都屬乎神。

verses.text: And lovingkindness is Yours, O Lord, For You recompense a man according to his work.
verses.textZh: 主啊，慈愛也是屬乎你，因為你照著各人所行的報應他。
